title: Question 22
passage:
Would Sunday morning be a good time to bring the seedlings over?
A. I put the taller ones in bigger pots. B. The pots can go on the back steps. C. I’ll be asleep after a night shift. Could you come after lunch?
passageZh:
週日早上把這些幼苗帶過去，方便嗎？
A. 我已經把比較高的幾株移到大一點的盆裡了。 B. 盆栽可以放在後門的臺階上。 C. 我上完夜班後那時會在睡覺。你可以午餐後再來嗎？
